description: Check the current screen for controls TalkBack and VoiceOver users cannot use. Lists every button, link, field or other control with no accessible name (missing_label) and every tap target under the platform minimum (small_target: 48 dp wide or high on the Android style, 44 pt on the iPhone style). Each issue has ref, role, code and message. Fails with sizes_unavailable when the simulator cannot report sizes.
name: a11y_audit
